speakers.name: Jamie Feldman (on behalf of Blaine Heck)

headline.text: Management wording (confident vs cautious cues, -1..+1): prepared +1.00, qa +0.50

tone.method: lexical cue counts on management sentences; indicative of wording, not a measure of business health

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: We delivered another exceptional quarter driven by strengthening demand, disciplined execution, and the expanding capabilities of our platform.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: We signed a record 67 million sq ft of leases during the quarter, and after several quarters of sustained demand, we believe the market is entering its next phase.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: We're putting that demand to work through disciplined investment.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: Our 14,000 acre land bank represents 240 million sq ft of embedded development opportunity.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: Our power pipeline has expanded to approximately 5.8 GW, representing about $17 billion of powered shell investment potential or up to $87 billion on a turnkey basis.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: They're looking for integrated solutions across logistics, energy, and warehouse operations.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: That insight helps us anticipate demand, shape our development pipeline, and stay ahead of the market.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: During the quarter, we closed our $1.2 billion European joint venture with La Caisse, further expanding that long-standing relationship and reflecting strong demand for high quality logistics assets.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: Prologis remains the partner of choice for investors seeking scale, execution, and access to the highest quality logistics portfolio in the world.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: We're confident in where the business is headed and remain focused on creating long-term value for our shareholders.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We generated $83 million of promote revenue in the quarter, driven by outperformance from three vehicles, underscoring the performance-driven nature within our strategic capital business.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Notably, our portfolio lease mark-to-market remained unchanged from the prior quarter at 17% on a net effective basis, fully replenishing our embedded NOI opportunity of nearly $800 million available without any further market rent growth.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Turning to capital deployment, as Dan mentioned, we started over $1.6 billion in new development during the quarter, including approximately $800 million in logistics properties.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We acquired $1.8 billion of real estate during the quarter at an estimated discount to replacement cost of approximately 20%, executing on our strategy to go deeper within our existing markets.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Stepping back, the underwritten IRRs on our acquisitions have exceeded the IRRs on our dispositions by 140 basis points year to date, achieving both ongoing portfolio optimization while enhancing long-term returns.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Finally, contributions totaled $500 million for the quarter, demonstrating continued execution of our business model, which crystallizes value creation, recycles capital, and grows AUM and revenues within our strategic capital business.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: As an update on data centers, we had an exceptional quarter with advancement of our priorities in every facet of this growing business.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We started a 260 MW build-to-suit campus with total expected investment of approximately $800 million.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We've now commenced nearly $4 billion of data center development, all build-to-suit for the highest quality digital infrastructure customers, with more than 50% of this capital invested in turnkey projects.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: During the quarter, we also completed a 100 MW power land sale, generating an 82% margin and illustrating our disciplined approach to maximizing risk-adjusted returns by monetizing projects at the stage where we see the greatest profit margin.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: The breadth of this activity demonstrates that our data center business is driven by an integrated platform that consistently originates, develops, and realizes value.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: This contributed to vacancy declining to 7.2%, while market rents increased approximately 70 basis points.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Customer demand is broadening with notable and growing strength across e-commerce, advanced manufacturing, and increasingly customers supporting the build-out of digital infrastructure.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Alongside these secular additions, demand from our largest segment, basic daily needs and the logistics that support them, remains healthy.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Demand remains robust, and vacancy has been stable and relatively tight at 5.2%.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: This has been translating to rent growth, which increased approximately 60 basis points during the quarter and 160 basis points from the trough last year.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Large format space remains in tight supply, creating upward pressure on rents and adding depth to our build-to-suit pipeline.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We have very limited availability in spaces larger than 500,000 sq ft and no availability whatsoever in spaces larger than 1 million sq ft. At the same time, occupancy is improving across smaller units in nearly all of our markets.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Appraised values across our strategic capital platform increased approximately 1% quarter-over-quarter.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Our debt-to-EBITDA ratio ended the quarter at 4.7x, building tremendous borrowing capacity, especially when considering the scale of our balance sheet.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We are raising our outlook to reflect the strength of our operating performance and continued visibility into earnings growth.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: This increase, together with our second quarter outperformance, drives our expectation for net effect of same-store growth of 5.25%-5.75% and cash same-store growth of 6.75%-7.25%.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Strategic capital revenue, excluding promotes, remains unchanged at $660 million-$680 million, while net promote income is now expected to be flat on the year.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We are increasing development starts, and this on an owned and managed basis, to a range of $5.5 billion-$6.5 billion, reflecting strong demand and expanding opportunities.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We are also increasing acquisitions to $1.5 billion-$2 billion and expect contributions and dispositions to range from $4.25 billion-$5.25 billion, consistent with our strategy of recycling capital and optimizing portfolio returns.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Putting it all together, we are raising our net earnings guidance to $4.40-$4.55 per share.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We are executing across every part of our platform, from operations and development to strategic capital data centers and energy, at a time that market conditions continue to improve.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Occupier and investor demand is broadening, rent growth is re-accelerating, and our customers continue to turn to us for increasingly integrated solutions.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: Combined with the strength of our balance sheet and the scale of our platform, we believe these trends position Prologis to continue creating value today while extending our long-term growth opportunity.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: What I would say is this: we've been very consistent over time in how we think about M&A. The bar is high.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: We'll always be disciplined on price.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: It's been a really steady level of improvement and execution, and we're as pleased as anybody to see the market also coming along.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: The specific answer to your question is, if we see market rents achieve a growth level that exceeds rent change in any given year by roll, right, that's just going to be the math of when we would then turn to see it expand again.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We would hold out the possibility that that could occur, especially when we look at not just the standing lease mark-to-market that we have, but when we evaluate replacement cost rents as well, which you know are very favorable.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: I think what you should look at is just the continued outperformance in occupancy, and you're seeing us just take more and more market share every quarter.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: That's our fourth record in the past seven quarters.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: They're investing in their supply chains.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: You've heard us talk about our big box availability.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: Companies are just getting more comfortable investing in their supply chains, competing and winning for revenues.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: There are categories that reflect growth opportunities in the future that are underpunching their weight.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: That's really great momentum.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: Market rents and occupancies have stabilized and begun to grow again.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: The specific numbers you're looking for, net absorption, we see that amounting to 220 million sq ft in the U.S. this year, and it's all the things Dan described as it relates to the dialogue we're having with customers, our pipeline, and the breadth across markets and sizes.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: Putting it together, the markets are entering a new phase of growth, and it sets us up to see more consistent and sustained rent growth going forward as the occupational recovery emerges.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: We're anticipating that growth has the position to become more consistent going forward.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: As this operational recovery becomes more broad-based, we could see inflation plus style growth emerge over time, given where market rents are relative to replacement costs.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: Now looking forward, barriers to supply, both at the municipal and at the state level, should help accelerate the recovery as conditions firm.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: The build-to-suit pipeline is growing.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: I feel very good about that build-to-suit volume and just where our customers are and just the fact that there are so few large format buildings available.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: When you have 14,000 acres of land and 240 million sq ft of opportunities, it really plays out well for us.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: I might pile on there and just highlight as well that the margin is what best contextualizes that mix then together with our expectations on stabilized cap rates.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: What I'm very proud of is the fact that we told you all what we were going to do in 2023 with this data center business, and that was around building a pipeline, that was around building internal capabilities, that was around round-tripping properties.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: We put the 10 GW out there as a projection that we're very confident in that we're going to deliver.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: It's grown since 2023, and we'll see how this team is able to continue to outperform.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We've talked about opening up capital availability via our logistics development ventures, et cetera, and we're really clearing the decks for having all of the capital availability here that'll be necessary to take advantage of what has indeed been a growing opportunity.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: I would say we've essentially completed a review of what's available in the market.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: That's where the largest component of nominal value creation resides, and we feel very good about our capacity to do so.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: These deals have a tremendous uplift in land basis to get to fair market value for powered land.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: That portfolio, our FIBRA vehicle there is excellent and has outperformed the market, meaningfully generating a promote.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: We feel very good about it and look forward to its future.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: With regard to the acquisitions in the quarter, we feel great about what was bought there.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: Look at the market share that we're taking every quarter when you look at the occupancy.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: We just adjusted up our development starts for the second time this year, given the confidence that we have in the markets that we selected to buy this land and develop out our logistics business.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: In terms of different geographies and the spread, I don't know that we'll have any markets with a decline over the next 12 months, the best geographies will definitely outperform inflation.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: The approvals and entitlements continue to be a growing issue.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: I'd say that's really where Prologis differentiates in a big way.

signals.speaker: Dan Letter
signals.sentence: It's just the evolution of how these things play out, and it's on us to be as far out in front of these as we possibly can and be the most responsible data center developer there is.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: There's healthy, secular demand drivers.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: That's what gives us our confidence.

signals.speaker: Chris Caton
signals.sentence: We have introduced a consensus source for you to be able to see this.

signals.speaker: Tim Arndt
signals.sentence: As you saw, we're very proud of the build that we had over the quarter and feel great about the balance of the year.
